authority: SA ruling explicitly supplied by the user in this task

decisions.subject: Return/Settlement Replay
decisions.ruling: Append-only reversal/clawback; do not overwrite historical Ledger or PAID. Reverse PV/BV/RPV/EPV and deterministically replay affected settlement and K0/K1/K2 downstream dependencies using the historically effective parameter snapshot. Re-derive carry from replayed effective volume; never reset it mechanically.

decisions.subject: EPV
decisions.ruling: Qualification + calendar month cumulative eligible personal consumption; max(0, consumption - NT$2000) * 60%. 4800 => 1680. Returns recompute that month's cumulative threshold; never subtract return amount * 60% mechanically.

decisions.subject: Settlement cut-off
decisions.ruling: Versioned period/cut-off/timezone/effective_from/effective_to configuration and settlement-time snapshots. No hardcoded weekday/time. Operational cut-off remains configuration pending until formally approved.

decisions.subject: SSOT / legacy drift
decisions.ruling: Filed documents > formally approved company documents > R1.0 system specifications > discussion/posters/legacy. Formal pools 42/36/15/5/2 and EPV 4800 => 1680. Conflicting legacy tests/fixtures are Legacy Test Drift; do not alter formal rules to satisfy them.

pendingDecisions.subject: Redistribution of monthly EPV return differences across historical award recipients
pendingDecisions.reason: Monthly threshold is settled. Allocation when same-month events have different Active/Sponsor snapshots is not specified; no latest-first/pro-rata allocation is inferred.

pendingDecisions.subject: Eligible personal consumption outside existing REPURCHASE and order netAmount representation
pendingDecisions.reason: The ruling does not define eligibility of other purposes, tax/discount/freight allocation. Existing REPURCHASE netAmount eligibility is retained, not extended.
